授業概要
履修者の研究報告について、大学院生と教員で討論する
Six faculty members will co-teach this series of lectures on East Asian and Japanese history. The series will cover a range of topics from the ancient to modern eras, focusing on the multifaceted interaction between Japan and East Asia throughout the course of history.
